account_number.description: Unique. This spec numbers by type: 1xxx assets, 2xxx liabilities, 3xxx equity, 4xxx revenue, 5xxx cost of sales, 6xxx-7xxx expenses, 8xxx other income and expense.

normal_balance.description: Debit for assets and expenses, credit for liabilities, equity and revenue. Contra accounts (accumulated depreciation, owner draws, sales returns) flip it.

parent_account.description: Account number of the parent for sub-accounts, or blank.
